name: vibra
description: Write, check, run, and test Vibra programs: the language, its standard library, and the vibra CLI.

interface.longDescription: Skills for the Vibra pre-alpha: write idiomatic Vibra source with its types, effects, and standard library, and drive the vibra CLI to format, check, run, and test projects.
defaultPrompt: Write a Vibra program that reads a file and prints its line count.
